_comment: CSV fields as written, each [text, field], checked by both web/src/lib/csv.ts (field, through writeCsv) and server/internal/ownership/export.go (csvField). Text starting like a formula (= + - @) after any whitespace (JavaScript's \s), or starting with a tab or CR, gets an apostrophe first, except a plain negative number. A field holding a comma, quote, line end, ; or tab is quoted.
